request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:CATAPULT

layers.text: Recolour only the shadows of the snow: every blue and blue-grey shadow tone on the body, arms, legs and head becomes a pale neutral grey like shaded snow, colour #d2d4d6, darker #aeb1b5 in the deepest folds, so no snow is blue; the lit snow becomes pure white #fbfbf8. Keep the bright blue ice crystals, the dark slate boulder, the black eyes and mouth, the shapes, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
